modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Hand baggage goes in the overhead bin or under your seat, space permitting.

carryon_weight.value: One hand bag of maximum 7 Kg, including a laptop. Overweight hand baggage found at the boarding gate is charged.

allowance.value: 1 bag of 15 kilograms free checked baggage per passenger; the fare table lists 15 kg for the Economy Regular fare. Your allowance is as per the fare rules on your ticket.
allowance.notes: The fare table on starair.in/FaresAndRules lists 20 kg for other fares, but its columns cannot be matched to fares unambiguously, so only the Regular fare figure is given.

excess_fees.value: At the check-in counter: INR 600 for every extra kilogram. Pre-booked online (non-refundable): 5 Kg Rs. 2750, 10 Kg Rs. 5500, 15 Kg Rs. 8250, 20 Kg Rs. 11000, 30 Kg Rs. 16500.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: Star Air's fare rules under its policy effective from 16th SEP 26.

cheapest_fare.value: Economy Regular (base fare): 7 kg cabin baggage and 15 kg checked baggage. Changes cost ₹ 3000 beyond 72 hrs or ₹ 3500 between 2 hrs and 72 hrs before departure, plus fare difference; no changes within 2 hrs. Cancellation costs ₹ 3500 beyond 72 hrs or ₹ 4500 between 2 hrs and 72 hrs; non-refundable within 2 hrs. On a no-show only applicable taxes are refunded.

free_cancellation.value: No cancellation fee if you cancel within 24 hours of booking for travel more than 7 days away.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Star Air does not pay compensation or provide facilities for cancellations and delays caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond its control.

rebooking_refund.value: If a flight is cancelled or rescheduled by more than two and half hours (depending on the length of the journey), you can choose a refund or rebooking onto an alternative Star Air flight at no additional cost, subject to availability, as per DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV.

compensation.value: If you are eligible for compensation under DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV, claim by emailing customercare@starair.in from the email address on the booking; it is paid after KYC document checks.

meals.value: If your flight is cancelled and you are already at the airport by the original flight time waiting for the alternate flight, Star Air provides free meals and beverages.

online_checkin.value: Web check-in opens 72 hours before scheduled departure.
online_checkin.notes: The conditions of carriage give two different closing times for web check-in (2 hours and 60 minutes before departure), so the closing time is not stated.

airport_checkin.value: Airport check-in opens 2 hours before and closes 60 minutes before scheduled departure.

gate_close.value: Boarding gates close 25 minutes before scheduled departure. Not reaching the gate by then counts as a no-show: the fare is retained and only taxes and government or airport charges may be refunded.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
